artworks.label: Mirror tambourine
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE completely new original square1024x1024 standalone Glaze small-widget artwork for disco-drift. One elegant1970s disco tambourine, slim tangerine-orange enamel hoop set with tiny mirrored-silver mosaic panels, polished lilac-metal jingles, a loose plum satin ribbon tied at one side. Sophisticated contemporary collectible sculpture, realistic glass reflections, periwinkle/plum/tangerine/iridescent-silver palette, warm glancing studio light. No cassette, headphones, mirror frame, jellyfish or extra instruments. Whole subject centered, readable silhouette, ample18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, square, ground plane, border or collage. Pure illustration only: no text, numbers, dates, clock hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Do not copy/crop/recolour an existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
